minutes.headline: Green Communities group heard a grant update and summit report, and set a January 6 virtual meeting.
minutes.summary: The chair reported on the town's Green Communities grant application, which mostly funded school heat pump and controls work and awaits a state decision. He then reviewed new state and federal energy programs from the Green Communities summit and discussed Turkey Hill's future. Members agreed to meet virtually on January 6 and to recruit new members, and the meeting adjourned by roll call.

votes.motion: Motion to adjourn, taken by roll call vote.

budget_items.what_was_said: The town applied for nearly the full amount allowed, just under the cap.
Refrigeration controls at three schools, a small scattering of items, and a mini split piece; utility incentives reduce what the town must spend.
The chair said the school received a free contribution toward a larger project.

budget_items.topic: Grant money line item in town budget
budget_items.what_was_said: A member said it is uncertain whether the grant money line item will survive into the next budget and asked the chair to pass the grant writer information to the finance committee chair.

budget_items.topic: State matching funds for federal grants
budget_items.what_was_said: A state program offers financial and technical assistance to pursue federal grants.
Tax-exempt towns can get money back for energy projects, with a base credit and added bonuses for prevailing wage and American-made goods.

budget_items.topic: Mass Save municipal energy manager grant
budget_items.what_was_said: A competitive program offers a funded energy manager for several years; the deadline is the end of January.

Chair to ask the select board's administrative assistant to move forward a prospective new member the committee supports.
